shared.normalization: Canonical v2 objective: meanCE+rho/2*(norm(V)^2+norm(U)^2/S)+lambda_b/(2S)*norm(b)^2. Keep fitted V unchanged across policies; no post-fit unit-norm rescaling.

confirmation.rule: Smallest integer n in [24,96] with t_(1-.05/3,n-1)*max(development SD of two selected null harms and strong gain)/sqrt(n)<=.005; otherwise stop. Check achieved widths, no extension.

selection: Common B3 first by minimum mean expected NLL over development population/offset/strong equally, tie1e-12 lower lambda. Eligible global candidates: w>0, both null UCB<=.01, strong gain>=.05 and LCB>0, recovery>=.5, contrast NRMSE<=.5. Max strong gain; ties1e-12 lower w, higher rho, higher lambda, lexical ID.
inference: Bonferroni one-sided t across two null harms and one strong gain, alpha=.05/3 each. Approximate for generated-world means; no exact normality guarantee.
continuity: Historical matched-component B3 tables per world, distinct from new common-B3 point and statistical gates.
